title: NZ Hopes Week and Challenge
location: Hamilton (outside our region, open to Wellington juniors)
details: TTNZ development week for under-12 and under-13 players: three training-camp days (16-18 Jan) then the Challenge on Wednesday 20 Jan. Players must attend all five days. Entry fee for Wellington and lower North Island players: $200.

title: Women & Girls Have-A-Go
details: TTNZ nationwide campaign around International Women's Day. Free have-a-go sessions for women and girls of all ages and abilities. Check TTNZ for your nearest session.

title: Have-A-Go for Brain Health
details: Free, relaxed sessions celebrating World Table Tennis Day: no skills or equipment needed, great for kids, parents and grandparents. Table tennis is a whole-brain workout (reaction, memory, coordination). In 2026 Manawatu and Whanganui hosted sessions; register through TTNZ.
